headline: Executive order sets up a federal office to support US government work related to Pakistan and Afghanistan.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order creates a new federal office called the Pakistan and Afghanistan Support Office. The office appears meant to help organize or support US government efforts involving the two countries. No summary was provided, so details such as its exact duties, staff, and budget are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies working on Pakistan and Afghanistan
who_it_affects.how: They would have a new office set up to support their work related to the two countries.
Some may be assigned to or hired for the new office.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on August 18, 2010, though the source does not say.
